skills.name: visual-antislop
skills.description: Audit and improve visually generic, repetitive or inconsistent product interfaces. Use during UI review, design handoff, or before releasing screens; preserve product brand and accessibility.

skills.name: ui-ux-auditor
skills.description: Evaluate usability, accessibility, navigation and interaction behavior using observable evidence. Use for user journeys, design reviews, and pre-release UX quality gates.

skills.name: requirements-validator
skills.description: Validate clarity, completeness, feasibility and traceability of business/system requirements. Use before estimation, architecture, coding or QA test generation.

skills.name: architecture-reviewer
skills.description: Review software architecture against functional and quality attributes, trade-offs, security boundaries and operational constraints. Use for ADRs, service design and major changes.

skills.name: clean-code-auditor
skills.description: Inspect code maintainability, correctness and engineering conventions with reproducible evidence. Use for PR review, refactoring decisions and technical-debt triage.

skills.name: database-auditor
skills.description: Review database schema, query performance, integrity and operational safety. Use before schema migrations, performance work, and releases affecting persistent data.

skills.name: bug-hunter
skills.description: Find, reproduce, triage and verify software defects using controlled tests and traceable evidence. Use during QA, incident reproduction, and regression analysis.

skills.name: test-case-generator
skills.description: Generate traceable, risk-based software test cases and coverage matrices from approved requirements. Use before test implementation, QA execution or release regression planning.

skills.name: security-auditor
skills.description: Perform authorized, evidence-based application security review using OWASP ASVS and WSTG. Use for secure design, PR checks, and pre-release security verification.

skills.name: iso27001-gap-auditor
skills.description: Assess an ISMS scope against ISO/IEC 27001:2022 and 2024 amendment with verified control applicability and traceable evidence. Use for readiness or internal gap assessments, not certification claims.

skills.name: cicd-security-auditor
skills.description: Evaluate CI/CD pipeline integrity, privileges, provenance and deployment safety. Use when reviewing GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, runners, IaC and release supply chains.

skills.name: audit-evidence-validator
skills.description: Validate provenance, relevance, integrity, timeliness and sufficiency of audit evidence and claims. Use before compliance reviews, release sign-off and external audits.

skills.name: cobit-governance-auditor
skills.description: Assess enterprise IT governance readiness through COBIT 7 themes, provisional COBIT 2019 traceability, evidence-backed risks, RACI, process assessment and monitoring; never manufacture official ISACA scores.
